title: ease-design ksync pins
description: Which Figma frame each built code route was built against. A pin says: the code at builtFrom matched this frame as of pinnedAt. Sorted by (file, node) so the file diffs cleanly.

node.description: Figma node id of the frame, e.g. 15742:548321.

pinnedAt.description: ISO instant the pin was asserted.

builtFrom.description: Git sha of the code HEAD the pin was made at.

specHash.description: Optional content hash of the frame at pin time. When both the pin and the ingest carry one, drift compares hashes and ignores timestamps.
